trayAreaDiscrepancy.note: The report states 0.24 m2 and its total-dry-matter average of 1546 g/m2 reproduces exactly at 0.24 m2 (371.0 / 0.24 = 1545.8). Its seed-mass-per-m2 column does not agree: the printed column average of 532 g/m2 requires 0.2328 m2, and the column average recomputed from the 16 printed tray values (520.25 g/m2) requires 0.238 m2. So the two published columns assume different tray areas, by roughly 1-3 %. All three figures are recorded; none is silently corrected.

targets.name: biomass time series
targets.eligibilityNote: Seven destructive harvests at seven distinct ages from ONE study. A growth curve can be fitted and its residuals characterised, but the series contains no replicate trays at any single age, so it cannot support a cross-validated predictive model.

targets.name: fresh and dry harvest yield
targets.eligibilityNote: 16 trays of dry-matter harvest yield from one study, with a documented stress allocation across trays. Tray-level variation can be modelled descriptively; the unit is DRY matter, not fresh weight, so it cannot be converted to the simulator's fresh-weight basis without an assumed water fraction.

evidence.description: per-tray age, height, plants, heads, spikelets, seeds, seed mass, total biomass, EBI
authors' own summary: 520 g/m2 seed dry matter and 1546 g/m2 total plant dry matter, EBI 32.4 %

targets.unitCaveat: DRY matter. Phase 6's simulator expresses yield as edible FRESH weight per m2, so direct comparison is impossible without an assumed dry-matter fraction. The report prints no fresh weight for these harvests.

targets.name: water recovery
targets.eligibilityNote: A single condensate-versus-added balance, 0.924, over one 74-day cycle in a chamber that leaked 20-40 % of its volume per day. It is the only measured recovery figure recovered and it is reported by the authors as a transpiration proxy, not a closed-loop recovery test. n=1 study.

targets.caveat: Chamber leaked 20-40 %/day during this phase and the added-water total includes plumbing losses, so the 0.924 figure is a lower bound on recovery in a well-sealed system, not a design value.

targets.name: O2 evolution
targets.eligibilityNote: Oxygen is never reported as a measured quantity. It appears only in framing statements about what a CELSS must provide. Producing an O2 number would require applying a stoichiometric assumption to the CO2 figures, which converts a measurement into a model output; that is exactly the confusion Phase 7 exists to remove.
targets.searchRecord: Full-text scan of the recovered corpus: 'oxygen'/'O2' occurs only in CELSS framing sentences (TM-102788 p.4, TM-102784 p.9,13) and in a volatile-organic-compound context in TM-109192. No measured O2 rate, concentration series or evolution curve was found.

targets.name: photosynthetic response to irradiance
targets.eligibilityNote: The response is printed as a described shape with two anchor points - net CO2 production at 60 umol/m2/s, a compensation point near 190-200, and linear increase to the 750 maximum tested. There is no tabulated response curve and no replicate at any irradiance, so only the sign, the linearity claim and the compensation point are usable.

targets.name: PPFD and photoperiod response
targets.eligibilityNote: Two operating points exist (534 umol/m2/s at 20 h and 660 at 24 h in Phase II, 530 at 20 h in Phase IV), and each has a harvest yield. But they come from different system phases with different sealing, nutrient control and, in Phase IV, documented copper deficiency. The two points are therefore confounded with phase, and no photoperiod series exists at constant irradiance. Two confounded points cannot identify a response.

targets.name: gravity-dependent growth
targets.eligibilityNote: Every recovered report is a ground-based chamber study at 1 g. No microgravity, partial-gravity, clinostat or flight plant-growth measurement exists in the recovered corpus. The simulator's gravity factor therefore remains an assumption and cannot be calibrated.
targets.searchRecord: Full-text scan for 'microgravity', 'gravity', 'clinostat': one incidental mention on TM-102784 p.13 in a citation context. No gravity manipulation and no gravity response measurement found.

targets.name: radiation dose-response
targets.eligibilityNote: No radiation dose paired with a plant response was found. 'Radiation' in these reports refers to lamp emission spectra, which is a lighting variable, not a dose. The simulator's radiation-sensitivity coefficients remain unsupported assumptions.
targets.searchRecord: Full-text scan for 'radiation', 'dose', 'gray', 'mGy': all hits are spectral-irradiance or lamp-output contexts (TM-103494 p.22-23 compares HPS to fluorescent spectra; TM-102784 p.12,20,51,56 concern lamp and irradiance measurement). No absorbed-dose measurement.

targets.name: measured stress outcomes
targets.eligibilityNote: Stress is recorded as a binary per-tray allocation with narrative cause (water stress on trays 1, 2, 4, 8; manganese stress on trays 6 and 7). There is no severity score, no measurement of the stressor, and no control arm. This supports a descriptive grouping label and nothing more; using it as a regression target would be manufacturing a label the source never measured.

evidence.description: flag-leaf epinastic rolling with poor seed set, later attributed to low tissue copper

targets.replicates: 5 labeled of 16 trays, 1 binary label each
